name: com.opus.sdk
description: Contract-first plug-in game SDK for the OPUS VR rehab shell: IGameModule, GameManifest/ParamBinder, GameRegistry, SessionClock, TrialRecorder, KinematicsRecorder, SessionWriter, Outbox and ITransport. Hand tracking is Meta XR SDK/OVRSkeleton, accessed only through IHandSource so recorders and games stay input-agnostic (SyntheticHandDriver feeds the same interface).
